name: 十二の気分から記録
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0001 十二の気分から記録, correction of candidate v001.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL source controls icons, artwork geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment, spacing and fine details. Image 1 is original Calm source, authoritative for all twelve expressions. Image 2 is the original stressed-emoji crop, authoritative fine detail; the dark square is source background, remove ONLY that background. Image 3 is our FigCraft mock: SECONDARY guide for exact Japanese content and overall grid only, not icon quality. Image 4 is v001, the edit target. Image 5 is the approved bus design, style only. All twelve original crops were inspected; the tool permits only five inputs, so the original full screen carries the other eleven expressions.
Targeted correction: retain v001's white surfaces, subtle neutral borders, shadow, complete twelve-item three-column/four-row grid and all Japanese labels. Replace its redrawn emoji with faithful original artwork from original image 1 and crop image 2, preserving the original eyelids, eyebrows, eye size, mouth curvature and emotional character. The unsure original has raised asymmetric eyebrows; the sad original has closed downcast eyes with upward inner brows; stressed original has squint creases and a small open mouth; sleeping original has the original tiny blue zzz. Keep original red hearts/tongue and white steam. Do not stylize or substitute generic emoji. Remove dark square background around each face without altering the face.
Correct heading to Meiryo Bold 20/28 at 390px logical width, not extra-black or oversized. Body labels Meiryo Regular 14/24 with tracking 0. Preserve original mock's heading-to-label relative type ratio, 20:14. Keep heading exactly two centered lines:「おはようございます。」/「いまの気分は？」.
Exact labels, row-major:「うれしい」「わくわく」「感謝している」/「落ち着く」「満ち足りる」「疲れている」/「迷っている」「退屈」「そわそわ」/「いらいら」「張りつめる」「悲しい」.
All choices remain UNSELECTED. No checkmark, footer, CTA, extra copy, logo, feature or metric. Pure white #FFFFFF canvas/cards/tiles; ink #1D1D1D; neutral borders, restrained downward shadow. No mint fill, colorful icon backgrounds or decorative green. Original emoji colors have meaning as artwork; no secondary accent is justified. There is no primary action here, so don't invent a green button. Preserve composition at 390x455 logical proportion with modest white margin, full card visible, readable Japanese labels with no clipping. Flat UI design candidate only, no device frame or comparison board.
reviewNotes: 最新の所有者指示に従い原画を図像・細部の主参照、モックを内容・全体配置の副参照として生成。原画全体と12クロップを実見、入力上限5枚のため原画全体・張りつめる原画クロップ・モック・v001・正式バス方向を供給。v002実見:12項目の日本語・順序・白面・未選択状態・暗い四角の除去は維持。迷っているの眉は改善。ただし張りつめる・悲しい等の図像形状は原画と異なり、原画保持と厳密な書体/太さには残差。限定修正1回後もneeds-correctionで保留し次部品へ。所有者承認・編集性・実装の証明ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
